title: 1969 AHSME Problem 22
statement:
Let \(K\) be the measure of the area bounded by the \(x\)-axis, the line \(x=8,\) and the curve defined by

\[ \begin{aligned} f=\{(x,y)\mid{}&\\ y&=x\\ &\text{when }0\le x\le5,\\ y&=2x-5\\ &\text{when }5\le x\le8\}. \end{aligned} \]

Then \(K\) is:

answerChoices.label: E
answerChoices.text: less than \(44\) but arbitrarily close to it

solutions.text:
From \(x=0\) to \(5,\) the region is a triangle of area \(\frac12(5)(5)=12.5.\) From \(x=5\) to \(8,\) the endpoint heights are \(5\) and \(11,\) so the trapezoid has area \[ \frac12(5+11)(3)=24. \] Thus \(K=12.5+24=36.5.\)

Therefore, the correct answer is C.
hints: Use a triangle from \(0\) to \(5\) and a trapezoid from \(5\) to \(8\)
